title: Rademacher summand
statement: For a natural number $n$, a real-valued coefficient function $a$ on $\{1,\ldots,n\}$, an index $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and a point $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define the $i$th Rademacher summand to be $a_i$ times the sign represented by the $i$th coordinate of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ assigns a real coefficient to each index
$x$ is a point of the Boolean cube
